This was the right thing to do. As per the man page, it's -i DEVICE, --input=DEVICE meaning that you can either do i <space> DEVICE or --input=DEVICE (no space). Although -iDEVICE (without space) should work too.

You should read some guide on how command line syntax is usually explained. For example, the guide to docopt. Now, docopt is a tool for programmers that's used to automatically parse command line parameters based on the program's documentation (so the programmer doesn't have to write any additional code) and not all programs use it, but the documentation conventions it requires and the interface it produces are the same that most developers actually use, so you can use it to learn how command line syntax is usually described, even if you aren't a programmer at all.
